failures.symptom: Explosive numerical runaway (> 10^3 m/s) on dense meshes during unnormalized Jacobi accumulation
failures.root_cause: np.add.at accumulated corrections without valence normalization, causing compounding velocity increments
failures.remediation: Implemented Jacobi degree normalization (delta / deg_edges * 0.85) and clamped maximum vertex velocities to [-2.5, 2.5] m/s

failures.symptom: 1.8% residual penetration due to pinned collar vertices clipping wide humanoid neck meshes
failures.root_cause: Pinned collar vertices were omitted from collision clearance pass
failures.remediation: Enforced non-penetration clearance across all vertices while preserving horizontal collar pinning

failures.symptom: Hoodie hood cowl mismatch against legacy engine node key hood_shell
failures.root_cause: Synonym discrepancy between high-level clothing taxonomy and lower-level mesh graph nodes
failures.remediation: Aligned category component definitions to accept authentic engine node keys

failures.symptom: Connected components on class 6 (pants) isolated left and right legs into separate instances, inflating false positives
failures.root_cause: Walking stride or standing poses created disconnected 2D blobs for single pants garment
failures.remediation: Implemented lower-body taxonomic deduplication and mutual exclusion between pants and skirt

failures.symptom: Raw TripoSR / TRELLIS neural outputs capped neck, wrists, and waist with solid infill, causing 100% avatar collision
failures.root_cause: DMTet / Marching Cubes level set extraction in open-weight models does not support open boundary loops
failures.remediation: Engineered automated topology recovery algorithm carving open boundary loops and excavating cavity infill

failures.symptom: Remote NVIDIA A10G / A100 GPU cluster is not provisioned
failures.root_cause: Physical hardware constraint (local development executed on Apple Silicon M2)
failures.remediation: Enforced truthful reporting: remote CUDA explicitly reported as BLOCKED; local MPS development staging operational
